meta.title: Take part in a competition
meta.description: Enter a Friends of Animals competition through your school, or as an individual adult.

participate.title: How would you like to take part?
participate.lead: Most participants enter through their school. Adults can also enter on their own.

individual.title: Participate as an Individual
individual.body: If you are 18 or over, register yourself for a competition that takes individual entries, and pay the fee online.
individual.under18: Under 18? Enter through your school for now. Entry with a parent or guardian opens soon.

schoolNote.title: We encourage you to enter through your school
schoolNote.body: Schools judge their own students' work first, so every entry gets a fair first look, and your school can enter many students in one go.
schoolNote.ask: Ask your teacher whether your school is taking part.
schoolNote.link: Read about entering through a school

register.title: Register for {competition}
register.lead: Tell us about yourself. You get an FOA Participant ID, then pay the fee online.
register.free: This competition is free to enter.

fields.dateOfBirthHint: You must be 18 or over to register on your own.
fields.phoneHint: You need an Indian mobile number to register, so we can reach you about your entry.

invalid.phone: Enter an Indian mobile number, such as 98765 43210.
invalid.pinCode: Enter the six-digit PIN code, or your postal code if you live outside India.
invalid.schoolName: Shorten the school or college name.
invalid.consents: Agree to each document to register.

refusal.registration_closed: Registration for this competition isn't open.
refusal.institutions_only: This competition takes entries through schools and other institutions only.
refusal.fee_not_set: Registration opens once FOA has set the fee. Please come back soon.
refusal.dob_invalid: Enter a real date of birth, in the past.
refusal.outside_age_groups: This competition has no age group for your age.
refusal.already_registered: You are already registered for this competition.
refusal.consent_missing: Agree to each document to register.

register.minor: You need to be 18 or over to register on your own. Please come back when entry with a parent or guardian opens, or enter through your school.
register.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.title: My competitions
dashboard.lead: The competitions you registered for yourself, and where each one stands.
dashboard.empty: You haven't registered for a competition yet.
dashboard.comingSoon: Entries, results and certificates will show here too.

payment.title: Pay for {competition}
payment.free: This competition is free. Confirm your place to get your registration number.
payment.confirmed: You're registered. Your registration number is {number}.
payment.writeNumber: Write this number on the back of your artwork, and quote it if you contact us.
payment.checkoutReady: This place now has a fee. Pay it with the button below.

error.nothing_to_pay: There is nothing to pay for this registration.
error.fee_not_set: FOA hasn't set the fee yet. Please come back soon.
error.gateway_unavailable: Online payment isn't available right now. Please try again later.
error.superseded: Someone changed this payment while you were paying. Please try again.
error.invalid_input: Something went wrong. Please try again.
